_notes.placeholders: {artist} full artist string (map tokens through artists.json), {title} release title (never translated), {year} year, {album} album name (never translated), {role} = roles.ROLE_WORD[role] (EN), {role_lower} = the same in lower case, {verb} = roles.ROLE_VERB[role], {n} a number, {tracks} / {artists} the two catalogue counters from catalog_counts() (never hard-code), {slug} a track slug, {feat} comma-joined featured artists, {url} an absolute URL.
_notes.quotes: RU wraps titles in «…»; EN patterns use curly double quotes “…”. Keep the RU quote characters out of EN output.
_notes.plural: EN has one plural rule: {n} == 1 -> singular, otherwise plural (see plural_track / plural_artist). RU has three forms (трек/трека/треков, артист/артиста/артистов) chosen by build_who_mixed.plural().
_notes.year_album: The RU year field may hold the literal word «альбом» for album tiles (has_year is false then); the EN badge word is in ui.json ("альбом" -> "album").
_notes.counters_in_hub_stat: RU: f"{total} {plural(total,'трек','трека','треков')} · {counts['artists']} {plural(...,'артист','артиста','артистов')}". EN: "{tracks} track(s) · {artists} artist(s)" via plural_track / plural_artist.
_notes.unchanged: Patterns without Cyrillic (meta_line, iframe src, GA tag, CSS) are not listed; copy them as is.
_notes.telegram_labels: Footer/hub links to t.me/lesnymix and the chat: EN labels are neutral ("Telegram channel", "Telegram chat") because both are Russian-language; no claim about English support.
